short.title: Buto: 2600-Year-Old Complex Found Beneath City #Shorts
short.hook: A 2,600-year-old Egyptian complex was found beneath Buto.
script: A 2,600-year-old Egyptian complex was found beneath Buto.
Satellite radar revealed a 128 by 62 metre oval anomaly.
Geophysical scans showed thick brick walls and a 20 by 25 metre structure.
Scientists found a deliberate sand layer six to seven metres down.
The sand may have been an artificial foundation to prevent water damage.
Animal blood residues and a faience baboon figurine suggest religious use.
Was it a tomb, sanctuary, or sacred space for Thoth?
Tap the link below for the full case file.
short.description:
A massive 2,600-year-old complex was discovered beneath the ancient city of Buto in Egypt. Satellite radar and geophysical surveys revealed a large oval structure with thick brick walls, possibly used as a religious or funerary site. Researchers found a deliberate sand layer at depth, suggesting an artificial foundation to combat groundwater. Animal blood residues and a baboon figurine linked to Thoth indicate ritual activity. The exact function remains uncertain. Source: BGNES, https://www.bgnes.com/science/2-600-year-old-egyptian-complex-discovered-beneath-ancient-city-of-buto
Full case file: https://youtu.be/BDB2DcM3w14
